build_hubert_criterion: build a HubertCriterion instance with masked and unmasked prediction weights for HuBERT training
run_hubert_forward: run the HubertCriterion forward pass to compute cross-entropy loss on masked and unmasked frames
review_reduce_metrics: review the HubertCriterion reduce_metrics method to aggregate logging outputs across data parallel workers
create_hubert_config: create a HubertCriterionConfig dataclass to set pred_masked_weight, pred_nomask_weight, and loss_weights
test_compute_correct: test the compute_correct helper function to count correct predictions from HuBERT model logits
